label: DESIGN
blurb: Design the change first, then build the approved design.

stages.label: DRAFT
stages.instructions: Invoke the /design-first skill with the brief and follow it: brand-system mockups, screenshots into the transcript, push to the linked design project. Stop for approval — that approval is this stage's gate.

stages.label: IMPLEMENT
stages.instructions: Implement the approved design in the repo. List every file changed.

stages.label: VERIFY
stages.instructions: Screenshot the built UI (bridge-eyes) and compare against the approved draft. Run the frontend typecheck and build. Report results with evidence.
